method: Visually read the complete target Perspective across printed pages 186–187, cross-checked its identity on the printed DOI/download page, distinguished neighboring Perspectives in the same PDF, and inspected the full 300 dpi Assembly line graphic/caption crop. The summary attributes underlying domain dissection and mass-spectrometry results to the commentary and flags the primary paper as unavailable locally.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.186 title/byline; PDF p.187 DOI and Perspectives header
verified_claims.evidence: The printed title is Anatomy of a Fungal Polyketide Synthase, by Kira J. Weissman; DOI 10.1126/science.1157677 identifies the Perspective, not the adjacent commentary.
The diagram/caption assigns one hexanoate plus seven malonates to NSA and shows downstream oxidative conversion to aflatoxin B1.
UMA uses secondary structure, local hydrophobicity and family homology; the perspective says it helped predict SAT and PT locations.
Crawford et al. are reported to have reassembled seven mono-, di- and tridomain chunks; all reactions included SAT-KS-MAT.
The perspective reports high-resolution mass spectrometry detection of predicted intermediates attached to ACP and says the full set mainly produced NSA.
Weissman contrasts a chain-extension cyclization model with MS evidence suggesting full-length chain assembly before ring installation; wording is suggestive, not direct timing observation.
The author says PksA relatives may make results generalizable but explicitly notes partially and highly reducing PKSs remain more complex and unresolved.
The unnumbered Assembly line figure and full caption are included; no table or additional scheme appears in the target Perspective.
The piece cites Crawford et al., Science 320, 243 (2008); the referenced primary paper is not present in this attachment and is not independently summarized as read.

unresolved_source_issues: 本文为Perspective，主要转述同一期Crawford等人的原始研究；原始论文和Supporting Information未包含在本条本地附件中。
短评没有逐项列出拆分构建体、蛋白制备、定量产物、重复数与原始质谱；不据此重建未展示的数据。
作者关于全长链先形成再安装环系的表述是对质谱结果的解释，短评未提供直接实时反应顺序观察。
短评讨论非还原型PksA并提出对其他真菌PKS的潜在推广，尚未在本文中完成跨物种或还原型系统验证。
